fields.label: Job Category
fields.note: Checkbox data-facet-type=1 IDs from the page's Filter Results panel.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: The page also publishes State/Region and City location facets; all use the fl parameter with their own facet IDs.

notes: Radancy TalentBrew search on jobs.intuit.com (tenant 27595). The search module requests GET /search-jobs/results with Keywords, Location, fc (Job Category facet IDs), fl (location facet IDs), fcf (custom facets), SortCriteria and RecordsPerPage; the unfiltered listing reports 609 jobs, and Keywords=software with fc=68338 returned 309 rows while the response echoed data-filtered-categories="68338". The Filter Results panel renders Job Category, Country, State/Region, City, Divisions and custom-field facets, and the Sort Jobs select offers Relevancy/Date Posted/Date Updated. The server-rendered ?p=N listing mirrors the same widget.
